classification_rules.applied_by: backend/app/batch/command_rules.py (matched_rules / classify_command), identically to every entry
classification_rules.decision: COMMAND_NOT_A_RUN if ANY rule matches, else PRIMARY

R1_INSTALL.description: an install step: a setup.py/install script, or an `install`/`develop` argument

R4_SETUP_SCRIPT.description: a setup/preparation script (stem starts with pre_run, prepare, setup_ or init_env)

R5_PLACEHOLDER.description: an unfilled placeholder in an argument after the target: a $VAR/${VAR} reference, an [a|b] choice list, or a whole value in ALL_CAPS with at least one underscore (CONF_FILE, LOG_DIR; not TTL2, D4)

classification_rules.target: the first `python|python3|bash|sh <path>.py|.sh` or `python -m <module>` after optional leading VAR=value assignments; stem = script file name without extension, or the module's last dotted component; args = the shell-split words after the target

command_not_a_run.definition: Entries whose recorded command matches at least one rule below. They are executed exactly like the primary entries (same harness, same caps) and reported separately as category COMMAND_NOT_A_RUN; they are never counted in the recovery rate or any headline number.
command_not_a_run.note: #18 is preprocessing in the manual review; the rules catch it through R5 ($RAW_DATA_DIR) only — R3 matches stems starting with 'process'/'preprocess', not 'read_raw'.

entries.command: python -m main.train -data_root data/kinship/S1 -slice_dim 8 -batchsize 16 -use_gcn 1 -embedding_size 64 -gcn_free_size 32 -load_method 0 -exp_folder exp -exp_name kinship -device cuda
entries.name: expressGNN__ExpressGNN

no_outcomes_observed: At classification time no corpus-v1 entry had been executed by RERUN (no baseline, no repair, no verdict for any of the 20). The classification reads only the command strings in corpus.yaml. The only live runs since the draw are development runs of TTPT (dev_run: true), which is not a corpus-v1 entry.

primary_endpoint.definition: The entries whose recorded command is a genuine run of the paper's code (no rule below matches). The recovery rate and every headline number are computed over these entries only.

reporting.blocked: primary entries with final verdict BLOCKED, broken down by taxonomy code (reason)
reporting.failed_as_published: primary entries whose baseline (declared install + recorded command, before RERUN changes anything) FAILS
reporting.headline: PRIMARY: <recovered>/<failed-as-published> of 12
reporting.invalid_harness: primary entries ending INVALID_HARNESS (RERUN's fault) — reported, excluded from the rate
reporting.recovered: primary entries with baseline FAILS and final verdict RUNS_AFTER_REPAIR (RUNS_AFTER_REPAIR)
reporting.repair_mode_split: deterministic vs model_assisted, over recovered primary entries

sampling_unchanged: The corpus is run exactly as drawn: all 20 entries, their pinned commits and recorded commands, unchanged. This amendment changes only how results are analysed and reported.
